chunks: So wait for your Lord's command, and do not follow any sinner or disbeliever among them.

key_terms.کَفُوراً: disbeliever or one who is ungrateful

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran command regarding patience and obedience to sinners?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al--Insan, this verse serves as a concluding directive to the Prophet (peace be upon him), emphasizing steadfastness in divine decree while rejecting the influence of the disbelievers who reject accountability. Shia scholarship often views this as a model for the Imams, illustrating the balance between patient endurance of trials and the active avoidance of corrupt authority. It underscores the spiritual discipline required to maintain purity amidst societal pressure.
